感到排尿困難、頻尿、尿急或尿液顏色或氣味改變
生殖器區域是否有皮疹、潰瘍、腫脹或其他皮膚變化

review_notes.note: 下腹痛、異常分泌物、發燒畏寒等症狀可能與骨盆腔發炎 (PID) 有關，需與闌尾炎、子宮內膜異位症、泌尿道感染等鑑別診斷。
排尿困難、頻尿、尿急等症狀可能與泌尿道感染或膀胱三角區炎 (trigonitis) 有關。
生殖器區域的搔癢、皮疹、分泌物可能與念珠菌感染有關，例如外陰陰道念珠菌病 (VVC)。

rag_sources.excerpt: transmitted disease (STD). Signs and symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease The diagnosis of acute PID is primarily based on historical and clinical findings. Clinical manifestations of PID vary widely. Many patients exhibit few or no symptoms, whereas others have acute, serious illness. The most common presenting complaint is lower abdominal pain. Many women report an abnormal vaginal discharge. (See Presentation.) Diagnosis of pelvic inflammatory disease The differential diagnosis includes appendicitis, cervicitis, urinary tract infection, endometriosis, ovarian torsion, and adnexal tumors.
